title: Spike slim result
description: What a coding agent reads back from `spike run --json` or the `qa_run` MCP tool. schemaVersion 1. New optional fields may appear without a version bump; a field being removed or changing meaning bumps schemaVersion. Extra fields (for example `script`, `healed`, `test`) may be present.

verdict.description: pass: the flow worked. fail: something is broken, see failing_step. uncertain: could not decide; never treat as success.

console_error.description: First page error or failed request seen during the run, if any.

evidence_paths.description: Screenshots and other files saved for this run.

reason.description: One plain sentence saying why the verdict is what it is.

fix_hint.description: Only on fail: a short pointer to what to change.
